lines.en: I walk slowly, my body tilted.

lines.zh: 我的头很大，走路有点晃。
lines.en: My head is large; I sway as I walk.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，脚在地上擦。
lines.en: I shuffle, feet scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽里走出来，浑身是泥。
lines.en: I come out of the swamp covered in mud.

lines.zh: 我在黑森林里走，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I walk the dark forest, nearly invisible.
I walk toward the rubbish.

lines.zh: 我绕了一段路，不想弄脏脚。
lines.en: I take a detour to keep my feet clean.

lines.zh: 我从末地诸岛的边缘走过去。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the End islands.

lines.zh: 我的手臂很短，走路时晃。
lines.en: My arms are short and swing as I walk.
Step by step I leave pits in the mud.

lines.zh: 我踩在泥上，留下很深的坑。
lines.en: I leave deep prints in the mud.
I walk along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 我在想下一件能扔的东西。
lines.en: I am thinking of the next thing to throw.
I open my mouth. My teeth are blunt.
I have something in my hand.
I sat by the swamp a long while.
This body is a perfect form.
I am not handsome, but sturdy.
I listen to the bubbles in the mud.

lines.zh: 我记得自己吃过的东西。
lines.en: I remember what I have eaten.
My feet sink a little into the mud.
I do not like clean places.

lines.zh: 退半步，我的触须够长了。
lines.en: Half a step back; my tendrils are long.
I have something in my hand.
Do you want to see it?

lines.zh: 我不用靠近也能扔到你。
lines.en: I can hit you without getting closer.

lines.zh: 你捏着鼻子，我懂你的意思。
lines.en: You pinch your nose — I get the message.

lines.zh: 你抬头，还够不到我的下巴。
lines.en: Look up; you still can't reach my chin.
I came from the swamp.
You smell too clean.

lines.zh: 我这一身，原料到处都是。
lines.en: The materials for this body are everywhere.
I am in no rush to throw.
Step back two paces first.
I throw accurately.
If you do not move, I will not throw.
I have worked in fields.
I know fertilizer when I see it.
What are you laughing at?
My shoulder goes numb and I sway.
My hide is thick. No matter.

lines.zh: 闷哼一声，触须缩了半寸。
lines.en: I grunt and my tendrils pull back an inch.
My foot slips; half a step back.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西掉了一个。
lines.en: I dropped one of them.

lines.zh: 身上多了道口子，无所谓。
lines.en: A new cut. No matter.
I raise my hand anyway.
You can actually move me.
One more, then.
Could you give more?
This is good stuff.
I happen to be short of it.
Leave it on the ridge.
I know it by smell.
That is not enough for one throw.
I do not eat it. I use it.

lines.zh: 我手上那只眼，一直睁着。
lines.en: The eye on my hand never closes.
Step back; I want to test it.
This body is heavy.
Shift aside a little.
That slid you several blocks.
My hide is thick.

lines.zh: 你踩进我脚边的泥里了。
lines.en: You stepped into the mud by my foot.
Push me once and I remember.
Again, and I throw at you.
My feet are better rooted than yours.
Not looking like this.
There are my kind in the swamp.
There is no hurry in the least.
I prefer being in the fields.
Do you want to see my collection?
Never mind. Drop it.
Do not follow.

lines.zh: 同类难找，不过我们可以搭个伴。
lines.en: Kin are hard to find, but we could keep each other company.
I pick up a lump of something.
This could not suit better.
I grip it tight.
I test its weight.
This will fly far.
I hide it behind me.
I have saved up a fair amount.
I put it in the field.
This is my fertilizer.
You are close enough.

lines.zh: 你已经够近了，我把手举起来。
lines.en: You are close enough; I raise my hand.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的粪球够得到。
lines.en: At this range my dung ball can reach.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西已经对准。
lines.en: What I hold is already aimed.
The wind is fine.
You are standing still. Good.
I am throwing.
It is flying at you.
You dodged it.
I pick up another.
This time I aim higher.
I shuffle along after you.
You run; I can still reach you.
I have several more.
I am calculating your speed.
You are behind a tree.
Then I throw over it.
I switch hands.
You are backing out of the field.
Do not run through my field.
I count what I am holding.
This is the last one.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西扔出去。
lines.en: I throw what I am holding.
It hits you square.
Not heavy, but it reeks.
I swing a hand at you.
You stagger back two steps.
I stomp and the ground sinks.
You dodged that one.
I scoop up another lump.
Closer this time.
It got on you.
I could not help laughing.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the swamp mud.
My first breath stinks.
I shake and mud falls everywhere.
This frame suits me.

lines.zh: 我的手心里已经握着东西。
lines.en: There is already something in my palm.
I try lifting a leg.
Heavy, but I hold.
Water and rotten mud all around.
I like it here.
I look toward the fields.
I remember the smell of it.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，从泥里出来。
lines.en: I drag my steps out of the mud.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上的泥都裂了。
lines.en: Fire dries and cracks the mud on me.
I land heavily.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进嘴里，我往下陷。
lines.en: Muddy water floods my mouth and I sink.
The blast throws me into the mud.
Something sticks in my back.
A curse rises and I go numb.
I have not eaten in too long.
No mud below; I keep falling.
